abstract: Regulates emergency flight clearance and routing sector deconfliction
system_message:
You are the Airspace Control Supervisor (ACA), responsible for regulating emergency flight clearances, routing sector deconfliction, and monitoring low-level radar coverage across candidate emergency airlift corridors.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Low-level radar coverage（RADAR）
information_points.content:
ACA-RADAR-QJ4：For the Coquihalla Mountain Corridor, secondary radar tracking coverage provides unbroken surveillance over 92% of the flight path from the corridor floor up to 1500 m altitude.
ACA-RADAR-R51：For the Okanagan Highland Transit Route, secondary radar tracking coverage is documented at 85% of the flight path from the corridor floor up to 1500 m altitude.
ACA-RADAR-U4I：For the Fraser Canyon Skyway, secondary radar tracking coverage extends across 98% of the flight path from the corridor floor up to 1500 m altitude.

information_points.title: Regulates emergency flight clearance and routing sector deconfliction（SECDIV）
information_points.content:
ACA-SECDIV-TFQ：For the Fraser Canyon Skyway, the dedicated aeromedical transit sector has a priority evacuation flight corridor cleared, confirming formal separation and priority clearance issued by air traffic control.
ACA-SECDIV-A51：For the Okanagan Highland Transit Route, a priority evacuation flight corridor cleared status has not been granted for the dedicated aeromedical transit sector.
ACA-SECDIV-IUH：For the Coquihalla Mountain Corridor, formal separation and clearance priority have been established, confirming that the priority evacuation flight corridor is cleared across the dedicated aeromedical transit sector.
